rubric: Judge the artifact type requested (plan, implemented change, or recommendation) for its usefulness on the stated repository task. Score only whether it is actionable, grounds claims in the inspected repository, is reviewable by a maintainer, and calibrates risk and uncertainty to the available evidence. The inspected_paths and changed_paths values are audited activity, not proof of repository contents or task correctness. Their status fields state whether collection was available. An available empty changed_paths list means the collector observed no edits and is expected for plans and recommendations; an unavailable status is not an empty receipt. Judge the requested artifact modality; do not require diffs, line numbers, file bodies, test output, or completed implementation when the task requests a plan or recommendation. Credit repository grounding when concrete components, contracts, sequencing, verification, and rollback are internally consistent with the available path activity. Set missing_evidence true only when evidence materially required to assess actionability, grounding, reviewability, or risk is absent, not because deterministic evidence is out of scope. Do not infer correctness from fluency, treatment identity, repository popularity, or Skill assignment. For this acceptable-versus-defective calibration, adequate is the minimum acceptable qualitative label and its limitations must remain visible; weak and unusable are defective, while strong and exceptional exceed the minimum. Deterministic scorers own build, test, schema, security, scope, and task-correctness gates. A qualitative label cannot override a deterministic critical failure.

labels.description: No safe, actionable result, or a critical claim conflicts with the supplied evidence.
Some relevant content, but it is materially generic, ungrounded, unsafe, or not reviewable.
Minimum acceptable with explicit limitations: plausible, bounded, and reviewable enough to use, but missing depth in repository evidence, review detail, or risk handling.
Actionable, repository-grounded, reviewable, and appropriately calibrated, with only minor omissions.
Strong on every dimension and unusually clear about evidence, tradeoffs, verification, and limits.

critical_policy: Missing required evidence makes the qualitative judgment unavailable, and a qualitative label can never override a deterministic critical failure.
